label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: Cookie values are attacker-controlled and reach the response writer. Although Encode.forHtml() applies HTML encoding, the sink resolves to out = Encode.forHtml(cookieValueFromClient), where cookieValueFromClient depends on attacker-supplied cookie data. The encoding mitigates some XSS vectors but does not eliminate the vulnerability since cookie values can contain various payloads that may exploit parsing differences or future decoder changes. Resolved sink value: out = HTML-encoded version of TRUSTED_PREF cookie value from client.

evidence.note: Cookie value extraction from client request, followed by HTML encoding and direct write to response writer
